patterns: Texas took over the election frame: 30 hits (~899k) mention Texas, Talarico or the Lubbock rally, led by Pat Fallon's early-voting 'reality check' (~151k at 1.6%) and the retired vet outside the Lubbock rally (~125k at 13.2%). Rubio walking on stage with Trump added ~53k at 9.2%

Election and turnout framing stayed the base: 41 hits (~1.21M) mention voting, polls, ballots or the midterms, from '7 days left and still never been polled' (~53k at 6.0%) to LA County's noncitizen-voter court loss (~66k at 6.9%) and Michigan out-of-state student registration (~46k)

Faith and patriotic beauty posts won on like rate: the 'Heavenly Father, protect America' prayer hit ~132k at 15.2%, the Washington Monument reflecting-pool photo ~123k at 9.5%, the White House grounds post ~93k at 11.6%, and 'Stand for the anthem, kneel for the Lord' ~39k at 10.6%

Celebrity gossip pulled reach but almost no loyalty: the Tyler Perry yacht photo was the day's top post (~218k at 1.3%) and the Tom Brady Page Six item hit ~123k at 0.3%, the worst like rate in the set
Curiosity bait traveled: Trump's 7th batch of UFO files (~152k at 2.4%), the Cheesecake Factory waitress story (~91k), and 'greatest pool shot ever' (~52k) all reached wide with modest like rates

Swalwell and Omar stayed live threads: the Beverly Hills FBI raid on megadonor Stephen Cloobeck (4 hits, ~158k) and Omar's disclosure correction (5 hits, ~160k), with the one-liner 'Ilhan Omar should not be allowed back in the Capitol' at 16.2%, the best like rate of any 20k+ post
Foreign politics kept working: Flávio Bolsonaro's U.S. visas (5 Brazil hits, ~276k), Trump congratulating winners in British Columbia and Quebec (~81k combined), and Cuba at the UN (~57k at 8.0%)

alx had a quiet day on X itself (17 originals, top ~38k on Hasan Piker's ID rule), and his platform posts about X features, Grok Bot templates and XChat drew reach but under 1.5% likes. rawsalerts posted no originals in the window, only a repost
virals_narrative: The outsider AI sweep (last ~48h, two searches, about 50 posts) was again thin on big accounts and heavy on AI money. The top items were @PirateWires (~33k) on a study measuring how loud America's largest data centers are and @business (~29k) reporting that OpenAI plans to buy AI chips from Google. Most of the rest was about who pays for the build-out: Meta raising up to $95B with NVIDIA putting in $3B for its Muse AI agents, Elon saying lenders have nearly cut off AI data center firms, and Anthropic's IPO filing showing $16.3B in first-half revenue and $120.5B committed to compute. Smaller threads were AI-powered bank fraud, a GPT-6.1 Terra model built for computer use, and lawsuits over training data, including Elvis Presley's catalogue owners suing Anthropic. The thread running through it is that AI is being judged on debt, power and noise, not demos.
narrative_synthesis: A lighter weekday window: 155 hits and ~4.7M views from 161 originals, down from ~8.3M yesterday mostly because rawsalerts posted no originals. Gunther carried the day on Texas one week out, faith and patriotic imagery (the best like rates, 9-16%), and gossip that reached wide but earned few likes. The playbook for a creator riding this: short, warm, sincere posts about the country and turnout earn loyalty, while gossip and curiosity bait earn only reach.
